title: M_Fabric_Melusina — Sheer OIT Fabric Master v1 (draft)

asset.notes: Dedicated fabric/character lane parent. Slim fork of Universal kept lean per Docs/Research/UE58_TOON_MATERIAL_INTAKE_INFINITY_NIKKI_2026-08-08.md:188. Not a MI leaf.

governance.why_dedicated_parent: Versatile fabric master that merges textures efficiently, reduces variants, and works across platforms. Semi-transparent pieces have separate explicit handling and fallback tiers. See UE58_TOON_MATERIAL_INTAKE:188 and INFINITY_NIKKI_PIPELINES:21.

variant_policy.rule: One parent for all sheer Melusina fabrics (Shawl, Trail, HairCharm). Colorways are MI_Fabric_Melusina_* instances swapping T_Fabric_*_BC/N/ORM textures, not new masters. New masters require justification.

deferred_alternatives.MooaToon: deferred — Plugins/MooaToon does not exist per Docs/Research/UE58_TOON_SHADER_EXTERNAL_PRACTICES_2026-08-14.md:17; INFINITY_NIKKI_PIPELINES:85
deferred_alternatives.NextCAS_UE: isolated experiment not a V2 dependency per INFINITY_NIKKI_PIPELINES:87

wardrobe_slots.component_api: EquipGarment leader-poses same-skeleton garments; material never creates a second mesh authority

blend_and_oit.two_pass: Pass 1 accum color+revealage to RT_Accum/RT_Transmittance; Pass 2 composite. No depth write dependent on src alpha.
blend_and_oit.sort_priority_note: OIT removes correctness dependency on sort; SortPriority remains for coplanar tie-break (Shawl 10, HairCharm 15, Trail 20)

gbuffer.hero_tier_format: Adaptive (+15% cook, SM6/PC only, other platforms fall back to Blendable)

glints.note: Native Substrate glints require r.Substrate.Glints=1 and are not available on Blendable
glints.fabric_policy: Use custom Blendable-safe sparkle function only on Hero CelestialWeave instance; never native glint on Blendable sheer

texture_inputs.contract: Fixed 5-param contract on every MI_Fabric_Melusina_* leaf; no ad-hoc per-instance texture param
texture_inputs.real_source_on_disk: C:/EnvironmentPortfolio/wix/textures/pbr (56 PNGs, 90 MB, 12 sets) — 2048^2 silk/velvet + 4096^2 frontpanel/shirt per Docs/MPC_UNIFY_FABRIC_PLAN_2026-08-20.md:57
texture_inputs.reimport_table: Reimport over 32x32 stubs at /Game/Textures/Fabrics so GUIDs/references survive per Docs/MPC_UNIFY_FABRIC_PLAN_2026-08-20.md:52

channels.name: Normal
channels.note: Plus optional DetailN at second UV scale for jacquard/brocade

channels.name: ORM
channels.note: Stubs shipped as sRGB true — must be fixed to sRGB false + TC_Masks per MPC_UNIFY_FABRIC_PLAN:74/79

channels.name: FuzzMask
channels.sampling: independent UV/mip from ORM; not packed

channels.name: WindMask
channels.note: Plus vertex-color contract; mask and vertex color are complementary, not alternatives

channels.name: OpacityMask
channels.scope: Masked fallback tier only; ignored on OIT path

srgb_compression_table.stub_defect: Every _ORM/_H/_Mask/_Sheen/_Sparkle stub was sRGB true (MPC_UNIFY_FABRIC_PLAN:74) — fix after every reimport

core_upstream.role: warm pastel grade, already wired into Universal per UE58_TOON_MATERIAL_INTAKE:54

static_switches.name: bEnableSparkle
static_switches.cost_guard: custom Blendable-safe sparkle; native glint unsupported on Blendable per UE58_TOON_SHADER_EXTERNAL_PRACTICES:32

static_switches.name: bEnableIridescence
static_switches.note: false on Shawl default; true on CelestialWeave

static_switches.name: SDF_Relief
static_switches.note: never on sheer; opaque hero ornament only

scalars.name: SubsurfaceWrap
scalars.note: faux SSS on Blendable; no per-pixel MFP per UE58_TOON_SHADER_EXTERNAL_PRACTICES:30

parameters.registry_policy: Groups/units/clamps/defaults/tier availability/migration aliases go in specs/instance_parameter_policy.json before any MI promotion

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.features: full §texture_inputs contract, core graph, wind WPO on

tiers.name: Hero
tiers.note: Same graph; ToonProfile selection via parent tier, not runtime switch per UE58_TOON_MATERIAL_INTAKE:60

tiers.name: LowEnd
tiers.changes: OIT off, Masked OpacityThreshold 0.33, fuzz halved, wind off

tiers.name: FailClosed
tiers.guarantee: Renders opaque pastel; never pink missing-ref per UE58_TOON_MATERIAL_INTAKE:224 P0

slot_compatibility_table.note: Which Body+Shawl+Trail combos are valid — authored per outfit, stored as data here, not code
slot_compatibility_table.entries: to be authored per OutfitId; stub in this draft

clipping_profile.note: Per-outfit corrective bone poses for hair/hat/outerwear/shirt/waist; precomputed constraints for high-speed cloth & multi-layer collisions (see INFINITY_NIKKI_PIPELINES:37)

cloth_and_clipping.kawaii_boundary: Kawaii physics is presentation/presentation-layer WPO+phase only, not a garment cloth solver; dynamic skirt cloth stays disabled until skeletal deformation stable per INFINITY_NIKKI_PIPELINES:75. See KAWAII_PHYSICS_PLACEMENT_AUDIT:103.

fabric_instance_family.guardrail: Nothing in this spec modifies M_Master_Toon_Universal or its 1762 instances (cf. MPC_UNIFY_FABRIC_PLAN:144)

validation.no_editor_writes: per _AGENT_WORKING_AGREEMENT.md — spec PR does not create/move/delete any .uasset
checks: texture_inputs == BaseColor/Normal/ORM/FuzzMask/WindMask with sRGB/compression rows matching MPC_UNIFY_FABRIC_PLAN:79
ToonProfile == TP_Melusina, not switched at runtime per UE58_TOON_MATERIAL_INTAKE:60
fallback_tiers contain Standard/Hero/LowEnd/FailClosed with stated blend modes
static_switch combinations <= 8 and disabled branch disappears from compiled stats
zero new masters beyond M_Fabric_Melusina; variant count stays 1 parent + N instances
